title: The GUI project opens: a view and an input over the record, built on rx7.py and Claude Code, never a second home for any fact
SPEC.md is Camden's page to write in for the GUI; every idea raised in chat is written down as it is said, and the screen map starts from his home page of two options
SPEC.md is answered on a Notion copy while he works remotely; his words are copied verbatim into SPEC.md when he says he is ready

Rx7 is two real apps from one design - a desktop app on the Fedora PC and an Android app on his Galaxy phone - opened like any app; everything readable offline anywhere, answers staged offline and sent on the next connection, edits and Claude only online; no password, no notifications
The look: dark only, his five-colour palette, clean technical and calm; a roomy, photo-rich home and dense, tight data pages; subtle motion; finished to a standard he can show a hiring manager
The app replaces the Markdown pages: blocks, his answers, picks, TODO lists, decisions and the spec sheet live only in the record, and the app is how he reads and answers them

Screens and answering: home of two tiles, the project hub, each project's pages, list-and-focus answering with an Apply button at the top of each, Claude Code behind Explain, Discuss, chat and every run
The Manual is a placeholder page until it is planned with him; his spec answers on it are its brief, verbatim, and nothing in them is applied yet
